questions.subject: MODERN_PHYSICS
questions.learningObjective: Solve a quantitative accelerators and matter waves problem by applying the governing physical principle.
questions.stem: An electron is accelerated through 100 V in an electron microscope. What is its de Broglie wavelength?

options.misconception: Assumes a linear rather than inverse-square or exponential relation
Divides by the voltage instead of its square root
Multiplies by the voltage instead of dividing

questions.explanation: A nonrelativistic electron accelerated through V volts has wavelength lambda = 1.226 nm divided by the square root of V. For V = 100, lambda = 1.23 × 10^-10 meters. The alternatives use the wrong power of V and do not describe matter-wave diffraction in the microscope.
questions.hint: Divide 1.226 nm by the square root of the accelerating voltage.
